centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working with is the instinctive: returning to the body, to action, to the ordinary. Feeling already has its place — the point is not to let it occupy everything.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: The feeling that something is missing in you that others possess. This generates either comparison, or withdrawal, or a fascination with what wounds.
dynamique_ego.compulsion_evitement: Avoiding the ordinary, the banal, the common.
dynamique_ego.peur_de_base: Having no identity of one's own, being no one, being indistinct from others.
dynamique_ego.desir_de_base: Being fully oneself, creating a unique identity out of inner experience.

essence.qualite_phrase: You do not have to become someone — you already are, since before you knew it.
horizons: Touching the simple without belittling it
Inhabiting the present without amplifying it
Feeling identity at rest, without having to prove it

intentions_du_matin: Honor the ordinary — not flee it as if it were inferior
Finish something — not perfectly, just finish
Come out of withdrawal — answer when spoken to, without a mask
Take a concrete action — act before feeling
Not amplify — let what is stay its true size
Touch the simple — a tea, a face, a gesture
Stay when the urge to flee rises
Let come without grasping — welcome, don't identify
See an ordinary beauty and keep it for yourself
pratiques_du_matin: Before 10am, finish a single task — small, concrete, ordinary. Savor it as accomplished.
When the urge rises, breathe three times and name what is already here, present, in me.
Do a routine act (a coffee, making the bed) with full attention — as if it were new.
Write three lines by hand, not for beauty, for the trace.
Go outside for 10 minutes without a phone, just to inhabit the world.
Choose one thing not to amplify today, and return to it if it rises.

zones.description: Clear presence. You see your mechanisms without identifying with them. The ordinary touches you without engulfing you. Creation from what is, not from lack.
You stand upright, you do what's needed. The patterns are active but manageable — you feel them rise and you can choose.
The ego drives, you are a spectator. Mood seizes you. Comparison or withdrawal settle in without your being able to undo them.
Everything is heavy, you are engulfed. The lack is total. It's a hard day — it calls for gentleness, not combat.

details_riso.texte: Creation from being. Identity rests in itself, has nothing left to prove. The ordinary is honored, the simple touches deeply.
Self-aware, you recognize the envy that rises without following it. Sensitivity in service of the real, not of image.
Your creations honor what is. Singularity expresses itself without needing to be validated.
Romantic. You seize your mood as identity ("I am sad, therefore this is who I am"). Aestheticization of feeling.
Self-awareness that becomes self-absorption. Constant comparison, fantasy of a life elsewhere, cultivated melancholy.
Inhibition, withdrawal, moodiness. You cultivate suffering as distinction. Active envy, jealousy.
Self-rejection, destructive envy, self-disgust. Loop of self-accusation. Cut off from the world.
Depression, paralysis, deep despair. Everything seems useless. Feeling irreparable.
Collapse, self-destruction, suicidal ideation. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I compared myself
passions.detail: My inner world lost its value.

passions.label: I amplified what I lacked
passions.detail: The lack took up all the space.

passions.label: I cultivated intensity
passions.detail: Drama, melancholy, fascination with the tragic.

passions.label: I felt misunderstood
passions.detail: No one sees who I truly am.

pieges.label: I waited for the perfect inspiration
I seized my mood as an identity
pieges.detail: "I am sad, therefore this is who I am."

pieges.label: I looked for what made my suffering noble
pieges.detail: Finding meaning in what may have none.

moments.label: I was simply there, without needing more
I finished something without drama, peacefully
I reached out to someone without a mask
I welcomed what was, without transforming it
Lack had no hold on me
I felt a presence in me that was not the mood
I touched something that seemed to have always been there

remedes.label: Origin — who I am before the story
Grounding — the body before the mood

matin: Morning begins. What would you like to honor?
A day opens — what can simply be?
The ordinary awaits you. What do you want to place there?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. What is the state of things?
Here you are. How is your heart doing?
A pause is possible. What do you want to look at?
soir: The day fades. What do you want to keep?
You can just come, without saying anything.
The evening is gentle. A sentence, if it comes.
nuit: The night watches. One single thing to set down, then sleep.
You are still here. That is already a lot.
